description: Get the composite CEFI (Crypto ETF Flow Index) sentiment score across all tracked assets. Scale 0–100, 50 = neutral: above 50 means net inflows dominate (risk-on), below 50 means net outflows (risk-off). Zones: 0–20 extreme fear, 20–40 fear, 40–60 neutral, 60–80 greed, 80–100 extreme greed.
name: get_cefi_index
title: CEFI Sentiment Index
